## Summary

Describe the change and the user-facing or maintainer-facing problem it
addresses.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Installation or host integration
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test or verification
- [ ] Maintenance
- [ ] Other, explain below

## Public capability boundary

- [ ] I checked the published v0.1.35 boundary before writing this PR.
- [ ] I did not describe local, candidate, experimental, or unverified behavior
      as a public capability.
- [ ] If this changes a host integration, I stated whether the change affects
      local package reading or a user-visible host behavior.
- [ ] I recorded any remaining unresolved behavior or known limitation.

## Verification

List the commands, tests, manual checks, and environment used.

```text
Commands:
Environment:
Result:
Known gaps:
```

## Privacy and safety

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private canvas data, recordings, transcripts,
      Prompt Packages, sensitive screenshots, or machine-specific paths were
      added.
- [ ] Fixtures and examples are synthetic or explicitly authorized for public
      use.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details are reported through the private security
      route instead of this PR.

## Review notes

Call out any migration, compatibility, licensing, documentation, or release
note decision that reviewers should inspect.

## 中文摘要

请说明改动解决的问题、变更类型、验证命令和已知缺口。提交前确认内容符合公开 v0.1.35 能力边界，没有把本地候选、实验性或未验证行为写成公开能力。

请勿加入凭据、Token、私有画布、录音、转写、Prompt Package、敏感截图或机器特有路径。示例和 fixture 应为合成材料，或已经获得公开使用授权。安全敏感信息请走私密安全渠道。
